_about: Ranking weights and thresholds. Every number that affects order is here, not in code. Blend weights are applied to values between 0 and 1 and are shown per result in the explain output.

expansion._about: Vocabulary bridging. Weights multiply the text score of a match made through an alternative; all are below 1, the weight of the user's own words. Set enabled to false to switch it off for everyone; a single query can switch it off with expand=off.

weighted_match._about: Used when match_mode is 'weighted': a document must cover at least this share of the query (by term rarity); its text score is multiplied by share ** power.

_match_mode: weighted: a document must cover at least weighted_match.min_share_of_query of the query (words weighted by rarity among the documents the user can open); full matches score highest. all: every word required, falling back to any word when nothing matches (relax_to_any_when_empty).
